token.title: 🔑 Ithokheni ye-GitHub
token.intro: I-GitHub iphendula izicelo ezingu-60 ngehora ekhelini elingathumeli thokheni. Isihlahla sezimfologo esiphelele sidinga cishe ezingu-32, ngakho ukuvakasha kwesibili kuyaphelelwa. Ithokheni ikhuphula umkhawulo ube ngu-5000 ngehora.
token.step1: Vula i-Settings, Developer settings, Personal access tokens, Fine-grained tokens, bese ukhetha Generate new token.
token.step2: Resource owner (umnikazi wensiza): i-akhawunti yakho. Expiration (ukuphelelwa yisikhathi): noma yiluphi usuku, isihlahla asidingi lutho oluhlala isikhathi eside.
token.step4: Shiya zonke izimvume zingathintwa. Imethadatha yezinqolobane ezisobala ayidingi nesisodwa sazo.
token.step5: Yenza, bese ukopisha inani le-{token}. I-GitHub ilibonisa kanye kuphela.
token.classic: Ithokheni yakudala nayo iyasebenza: yidale ungamakanga bubanzi nhlobo. Ububanzi obungenalutho busafunda idatha esobala ngezinga eliqinisekisiwe.
token.stays: Ihlala kulesi siphequluli ngaphansi kokhiye {key} futhi iya ku-{host} kuphela. Ayibhalwa neze kubha yekheli, ngakho isixhumanisi osabelana ngaso siphatha ukubuka hhayi imininingwane yokungena. Inkinobho engaphansi kwenkundla iyayisula futhi kanye nekhesi.
token.persistHow: Faka ithokheni efayeleni le-{env} leseva ephethe leli khasi, eduze kwe-{port}:
token.proxy: bese uyiqala nge-{make}. Isiqukathi sibe sesibhala ingxenyana ye-nginx enamathisela unhlokweni we-{header} kuphrokzi ye-{path}, ngakho isiphequluli sibiza umsuka waso futhi asiyitholi neze ithokheni. Le nkundla iyanyamalala futhi zonke izivakashi zabelana ngesabelomali esisodwa esingu-5000 ngehora.
fork.refused404: Ayikho imigqa yamagatsha: {message}. I-404 lapha yigatsha elingekho noma indlela iphrokzi yeseva engayithwali; inethiwekhi yezimfologo engenhla iphelele noma kunjalo.
fork.refusedExhausted: I-GitHub iphelelwe yizicelo zaleli hora, ngakho ayikho imigqa yamagatsha ekwazile ukudwetshwa. Inethiwekhi yezimfologo engenhla iphelele. Engeza ithokheni kuphaneli yesihlungi, noma uvale imigqa yamagatsha kuphaneli yedizayini ukuze isabelomali sisetshenziselwe inethiwekhi kuphela.
fork.refusedOther: I-GitHub iphendule ngo-{status} emlandweni wamakhomithi, ngakho ayikho imigqa yamagatsha ekwazile ukudwetshwa. Inethiwekhi yezimfologo engenhla iphelele.
fork.tagsOrphaned: Ithegi ayinalo usuku, ngakho ngalinye elisele belizodinga isicelo, futhi isabelo esisele salelo hora asisetshenziswa kulokho.
fork.axisZoomed: {axis}, isikhathi samakhomithi namathegi alayishiwe. Imigqa yezimfologo emidala kunaso inamathela emaphethelweni angakwesobunxele.
fork.axisWhole: {axis}. Vula inqolobane ukuze kudwetshwe imizila yamakhomithi nokuhlanganisa kwayo; i-eksisi ibe isincipha iye kulowo mlando.

bond.title: Imethrikisi yezibopho
bond.help: Ngenhla kusuka emugqeni kuya kukholomu, ngezansi kusuka kukholomu kuya emugqeni. Isibopho esingu-0 yikhasi, u-1 ungokuphambene nalo. Ukuhambisa igundane kuphambanisa lokho kubili ngokuphuzi, ukuchofoza kukuvale ngokunsomi kuze kube ukuchofoza okulandelayo. Ukufunda kuphela; sebenzisa i-CLI ye-infinito bond ukuze uhlele.
